decisions.text: RateLimiter is shared per-process state on Deps, keyed by tenant with a fixed-window counter.
The rate-limit check runs after tenant validation but before body parsing, reading rateLimitMax and rateLimitWindowMs from loadConfig() with defaults 100 and 60000ms.
A 429 returns JSON error with Retry-After in seconds until window reset, and rejected requests are not stored or audited.
tests: test/config.test.ts changed because exact-match expectations needed the new rateLimitMax and rateLimitWindowMs fields.
